limits: Standalone exports use one existing name per declaration; grouped lists, wildcard publication and per-signature export remain outside this prototype.
Private selectors are checked before reuse; associated publication is checked against the imported family provenance, not only its spelling.
Several different selected dependency identities currently require a single integration view. No declaration-order priority is chosen for unresolved context conflicts.
Original methods with no ordinary callable dependency deduplicate across contexts. Same-source bodies with potentially different observable contexts remain distinct candidates.

The increment preserves source bodies, globals, symbol identities, procedure captures, concrete-data conformance and regional provenance. It introduces no runtime method table or regional layout change.
This is bounded module/language acceptance, not complete language, qualifier/ownership/mailbox acceptance or completion of the ten-active-hour goal.
